title: 第19章 大纛向前压上去第20章 有一位神通广大的贵妇人能把通讯打到我的前沿指挥所
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
一直闭目养神的太白金星却缓缓睁开了眼睛，伸出手臂，拦下了苏元。
他缓缓站起身，整理了一下衣冠，这位一贯以温和慈祥面目示人的老星官，此刻却透出一种前所未有的锐利光芒。
他迈步走向船楼的指挥塔台，众人心中一凛，连忙紧跟在他身后。
太白金星站在船头，望着远方黑压压拦路的天兵，声音平缓清晰地传遍整个船队：
“前两次的事情，我听说了。
木德星官和苏元，你们做得很好。
不卑不亢，合乎理法，维护了天庭的体面，也守住了招抚使团的尊严。”
他的话音顿了顿，语气陡然转厉：
“但是，有些事情，可一可二，不可再三！”
“武曲星暗中作梗，雷部奉命刁难，如今连军中莽夫也敢公然拦路！
这分明是主战派势力的负隅顽抗，是对玉帝陛下招抚政策的粗暴践踏！
是军中某些莽夫军阀习气的死灰复燃！”
“他们今日敢无视天庭法度，拦截钦命使团；他日就敢拥兵自重，祸乱天纲！”
“来人！”
太白金星的声音如同洪钟大吕，震得云海翻腾，“将‘勾陈上宫天皇大帝’和‘奉命巡天招抚总督’的大纛，给我插到主舰船头！
所有天舟，开启防护法阵，灵炉全开！”
老星君的手臂猛地向前一挥，斩钉截铁，声震九霄：
“全速前进！
大纛向前！”
“给老夫——压上去！”

巨灵神眼看那庞大的船队非但毫无减速之意，反而灵光更盛，速度再提，如同十二座呼啸的山脉直冲着他和麾下军阵而来，吓得魂飞魄散，连忙声嘶力竭地传令：
“散开！
快散开！
都给老子闪开！”
他自己那庞大身躯更是狼狈不堪，连滚带爬地向侧方云团扑去，才险险避开船头的锋芒。
他本奉命拦路想要恶心一下招抚组，结果差点丢了小命，惊魂未定地趴在云头，望着绝尘而去的船队背影，气得面红耳赤，跳脚骂道。
“太白老儿！
你竟敢纵舟行凶！
我必参你一本！”
苏元站在飞舟船头，从巨灵神身边飞掠而过。
心中暗忖：愚蠢，得罪了太白金星，巨灵神已有取死之道。
这种老文官玩死你个小武将，简直不要太容易。
content_en:
Taibai Jinxing, who had been concentrating with his eyes closed, slowly opened his eyes, stretched out his arm, and stopped Su Yuan.
He slowly stood up and straightened his clothes. This old star official, who always showed a gentle and kind face, now revealed an unprecedented sharp light.
He stepped towards the control tower of the ship building. Everyone was shocked and quickly followed him.
Taibai Jinxing stood on the bow of the ship, looking at the dark soldiers blocking the road in the distance. His voice spread smoothly and clearly throughout the entire fleet:
“I heard about what happened the first two times.
Mu De Xingguan and Su Yuan, you did a great job.
Neither humble nor arrogant, in line with the law, he maintained the dignity of heaven and the dignity of the ambassador. "
His voice paused, and his tone suddenly turned serious:
"However, there are some things that can only be done once and not again!"
"Wu Quxing was secretly obstructing, and the Lei Department was ordered to make things difficult, and now even the reckless men in the army dare to openly block the way!
This is clearly the stubborn resistance of the main war faction and a brutal trampling of His Majesty the Jade Emperor's policy of recruiting people!
This is the resurgence of the habits of some reckless warlords in the military! "
"Today they dare to ignore the laws of heaven and intercept the envoys ordered by the emperor; in the future they will dare to support their own troops and cause trouble to heaven!"
"Somebody come!"
Taibai Jinxing's voice was like a bell, shaking the sea of clouds, "Insert the banners that read "The Emperor of the Imperial Palace" and "He was ordered to patrol the sky and appease the governor" to the bow of the main ship!
All heavenly boats, activate protective arrays, and activate spiritual furnaces! "
Old Xingjun's arm suddenly swung forward, his voice resounding in the sky:
“Full speed ahead!
Forward! "
"Here I am - press on!"
The Giant Spirit God saw that the huge fleet not only had no intention of slowing down, but instead became more aura and increased its speed, like twelve roaring mountains heading straight towards him and his army. He was so frightened that he quickly shouted the order at the top of his lungs:
"Spread out!
Spread out!
Get out of my way! "
His huge body was even more miserable. He rolled and crawled towards the clouds on the side, narrowly avoiding the sharp edge of the bow.
He was originally ordered to block the road in order to disgust the recruitment team, but he almost lost his life. He lay on the clouds in shock, looking at the back of the fleet as it left, his face turned red with anger, and he jumped up and cursed.
"Old Taibai!
How dare you set up a boat to commit murder!
I will definitely read your book! "
Su Yuan stood on the bow of the airship and flew past the Giant Spirit God.
I thought to myself: I am stupid, I have offended Taibai Jinxing, and the giant spirit god has a way to die.
It's not easy for an old civil servant to kill you, a young general.
